dedupe_keys.name: opc unified architecture opc ua specifications

description: OPC Unified Architecture (OPC UA) is a platform-independent, service-oriented architecture for secure data exchange in industrial automation, from embedded controllers and sensors to enterprise and cloud systems, with a common information model and more than 150 market-specific companion specifications. It is maintained by the OPC Foundation, which runs working groups, publishes the specifications and certifies products. Coverage is global and cross-industry, used in manufacturing, process industries, energy and building automation; it was released in 2008 and unifies the older OPC Classic specifications. Specifications, samples, an IIoT starter kit and open-source stacks are distributed through the foundation's site and its licences and terms portal; some resources are free with no obligations, while others follow member terms, so access is best treated as registration. Caveat: this is a standard, not a dataset, and the overview page read does not list the specification parts or current version. For simulation it gives the information models and interfaces used to connect digital twins and co-simulations to live plant data, and to model the control-system layer in cyber and cascading failure studies. It is related to the ISA-95 record in this catalogue, which covers the enterprise integration layer.
